name: 佛山P1国际赛车场

corner_numbering.note: Official corner labels are T1–T17 on map_corners.jpg. All later analysis must use these labels. The earlier internal T1–T8 ids were a coarser GPS partition and are superseded; they are not the same corners as official T1–T8.

timing_line.note: Working point from the 2026-10-17 pipeline (N22.875316 E113.266340, heading 206.63°). Confirmed by the 2026-10-17 T17 calibration in official_T17_gates.json (same lat 22.875316, lon 113.26634, heading 206.63°). Approx lat 22.87532, lon 113.26634, crossing heading ~207°. Kept as-is. The green tick on the main straight in map_corners.jpg has not been surveyed against this point.

sector_lines_m_after_timing_line.note: Estimated metres after the timing line. The site does not publish sector coordinates. Kept from the earlier analysis.

lap_length_note: Approximate. GPS path length varies about 811–834 m by session. The 2026-10-17 note compared that day's laps (~811–820 m) with prior session B (~834 m). CSV path lengths: E about 816–850 m (one lap 849.5), F about 807–821 m. Official T1–T17 GPS gates are metres along the session E lap 8 reference path, length about 816 m (official_T17_gates.json).

ref_path.note: start_m and end_m are metres after the timing line along the session E lap 8 reference path (~816 m).

corners.note: Corner list follows the official schematic (T1–T17) on map_corners.jpg. GPS metre gates were calibrated 2026-10-17 against map_corners.jpg plus GPS/curvature on session E lap 8. Adjacent single-corner gates on compounds can be sensitive; coaching often uses compound groups (T3–T4, T5–T7, T10–T12, T13–T14, T15–T17). Do not copy legacy T1–T8 metre marks onto these ids.

list.note: 左发卡入口 - 主直道末端。Left hairpin entry at the end of the main straight.
左发卡 - 示意图左下
底直左kink - 可能全油门
左弯接回主直道。Returns onto the main straight.

legacy_internal_corners_t1_t8.note: Previous internal T1–T8 was a coarser partition derived from GPS (15 segments = 8 corners + 7 straights; three small full-throttle kinks were treated as straights). These ids are not official T1–T17 and must not be used in new analysis. Metre marks are the historical 2026-10-17 gates only.

corners.note: Described in that analysis as the bottom-left big U on the GPS plot.
